params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: request  Priority: P3
Summary: Under the transport price table a garage should only read that all prices are excl. 21% VAT, not the formula of how Stocklist builds the price from base price, margin and handover report.

Source: Portal mail:19.

The line `transport.prices_explained` names the margin and the express percentage, which are Stocklist's own tariffs (R P2-8.4). Keep it for the administrator; a garage gets only the VAT sentence.
params.title: Transport settings: show a garage only the VAT line, not the price formula
